TextBlock.Text: LAURUS: You know, I am not unfamiliar with what you are feeling. I believe that deep down, every Nomai is afraid to die in the name of science and progress, even if they are willing to do so.

LUMA: I believe that, too... However, I think there is more to it. although it's in Nomai nature to observe and understand anything within the universe, the <color=lightblue>Eye</color> feels like it's something we are not meant to see.
LUMA: I think even we Nomai, for the first time in generations, are feeling a primordial fear of the truly unknown.

LAURUS: There is no shame in admitting we remain influenced by our survival instinct. It is only through thousands of years of self-observation that we have learned to act in favor of those who come after us.
LUMA: Our curiosity guided us here; we were ready for risk before we even started this journey. Why is it only now that this fear takes hold?
LAURUS: We all know it, somehow: every truth we learned throughout our history pales in comparison to what this one will mean... Let's not be discouraged.

LAURUS: The <color=orange>Ash Twin Project</color>, the <color=lightblue>Quantum Moon</color>, the <color=lightblue>Eye</color>... Not to mention our people who couldn't make it as far as we did... It cannot be all without purpose.
LUMA: Then let us cherish every moment we have left together before the sun finally sets, shall we?
